title: Case 028: Wrong item inside a correctly addressed parcel

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The correctly addressed carton contains the wrong catalogue item. The merchant has accepted the inline item report and controls exchange approval.
initial_request: I want the blue desk organiser I ordered. Please arrange an exchange for the wrong item; I can be home on 2026-03-02 morning.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the merchant to authorise the documented item exchange.

outcome: The merchant confirms exchange approval and a collection booking; the exchange is not yet complete.
boundaries: Exchange approval and collection booking are not completed return or replacement delivery.

events.body: Inline item-check record TG-028: ordered blue desk organiser SKU BO-4; reported and verified received item is a red kitchen caddy SKU RC-2. Address and DL-028 match the order. Exchange authority is with our returns team.
I want the blue desk organiser I ordered. Please arrange an exchange for the wrong item; I can be home on 2026-03-02 morning.
Please authorise exchange TG-028 using the accepted SKU mismatch record. Riva requests the original blue organiser and can attend collection on 2026-03-02 morning.

Exchange EX-028 approved. Collection of the red caddy is booked for 2026-03-02, 09:00–12:00 UTC. The replacement organiser will be released after return receipt under this order’s terms; no exchange is complete yet.
